mapper.select: SELECT ur.role_id FROM iam_user_role ur JOIN iam_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND (ur.expire_at IS NULL OR ur.expire_at > #{now}) ORDER BY ur.id DESC
SELECT user_id FROM iam_user_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND role_id = #{roleId} AND deleted = 0 AND (expire_at IS NULL OR expire_at > #{now}) ORDER BY id DESC
